title: Scaling an overloaded server trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for scaling trace events: the replicas serving one endpoint, what each is holding, the traffic tick by tick, and what the run cost.

service.description: The endpoint being served, as the example named it (e.g. 'POST /checkout').

topology.description: SINGLE = one server answering directly; BALANCED = replicas behind a load balancer.

strategy.description: How the balancer picks the replica a request is sent to; NONE when there is no balancer.

now.description: The current tick. Time is discrete so a run is fully deterministic.

clientTimeout.description: How many ticks a client waits before giving up on its request.

healthChecks.description: How many ticks the balancer needs to notice a dead replica; null when it never checks.

localSessions.description: True when replicas keep per-client state in their own heap, which is what blocks scaling out.

capacityPerTick.description: Requests per tick the whole topology can start — slots divided by service time, capped by any shared dependency.

bottleneck.description: A resource every replica shares (a primary database, a gateway) that caps the whole fleet.

name.description: What the shared thing is, in the example's own words.

capacity.description: Requests per tick it will start, no matter how many replicas ask.

used.description: How much of that budget this tick has spent.

nodes.description: One entry per application instance, dead ones included.

alive.description: False once the process is gone.

inRotation.description: Whether the balancer still sends traffic here — a dead node stays in until a health check removes it.

degraded.description: True when this node answers, but slower than its peers.

concurrency.description: How many requests it can work on at once.

serviceTicks.description: Ticks one request holds a slot.

queueLimit.description: How many it accepts before refusing outright.

capacity.description: This node's throughput in requests per tick.

rejected.description: Requests it refused because the queue was full.

sessions.description: Client sessions living in this node's heap.

timeline.description: One cell per elapsed tick, so demand and capacity can be compared at a glance.

arrived.description: Requests that reached the service in this tick.

rejected.description: Requests refused by a full queue.

failed.description: Requests that never reached a working replica.

queued.description: Queue depth across the fleet at the end of the tick.

stats.description: Running totals for the whole run — the bill for this topology.

rejected.description: Requests refused because a queue was full.

failed.description: Requests that reached no working replica, or the wrong one.

wasted.description: Requests finished for clients that had already left.

sessionMisses.description: Requests routed to a replica that did not hold their session.

blackholed.description: Requests the balancer sent to a replica that was not there.

avgLatency.description: Average ticks between arrival and response.

peakQueue.description: Deepest the queue got across the fleet.

comparison.description: Only on TOPOLOGIES_COMPARED: the same traffic priced by each topology.

survivesLoss.description: Whether the topology still serves anything after losing one machine.
